_description: Extension schema for r/covidlonghaulers. Adds 3 COVID-specific extension fields on top of the universal base set.

infection_count.description: How many times the patient has been infected with COVID

long_covid_duration_months.description: How long the patient has had Long COVID specifically (in months)

biomarker_results.description: Lab values, biomarkers, or test results mentioned

_changes_from_v1: alternative_treatments and social_impact were promoted to base fields, so include_base_fields is now empty. functional_status_tier was promoted to base as well and is no longer redefined here.
